brief.text: Make a five-second vertical video of this woman on a midnight railway platform with one luminous golden fish floating beside her shoulder. Keep her recognizable and in the same amber coat. The fish gently swishes its tail as she notices it with a small smile. Keep her face and the fish separate, camera locked, no cuts, no text and no audio.
criteria: Midnight platform and floating fish visible separately from face
Small reaction and gentle fish movement without a cut
brief.design: One direct image-to-video call versus image edit then motion; same source, brief, video model and budget ceiling; not independent agent or blind review.

notes: MCP calls made by the same supervising agent; one sample per workflow, not a blind agent benchmark. File-ready times are observations including polling gaps. Setup and active editing occurred between calls. No seeds or retries. Uploaded paths and signed URLs replaced by local source references; upload bytes and use returned file_path values to reproduce.
